candidates.name: clankops
readme_excerpt: # ClankOps
Development control plane and institutional memory for the Clank ecosystem.
Foundation 5 can attach that observation to the open Mission as an artefact. Git corroboration from Foundation 3 is unchanged. Reconcile stays read-only.
Foundation 6 records **deployed/runtime** observations as their own evidence. Source HEAD is not deployed HEAD. CI success is not deployment success. Running is not authoritative.
Foundation 7 derives an **attention** queue from that evidence: what you are in danger of forgetting right now, and why. Freshness is metadata, not truth. Attention writes zero ledger events.
Foundation 8 emits a **derived resume packet** so any development agent can enter an existing Clank without the original chat. Admission never creates a Mission. The packet is not an LLM summary.

> **Phase 0: UNVERIFIED_PRODUCTION — promotion frozen.** Repository state is
> not proof of the deployed SHA, scheduler, database, notification authority,
> backup, or rollback target; those facts remain `UNKNOWN` in the fleet ledger.
Tablet Clank is an independent, evidence-first product-intelligence system for discovering meaningful tablet catalogue changes from first-party manufacturer sources.
Stage 1 is intentionally small: Apple's historical India sitemap remains a
disabled/untrusted source, Apple US/India iPad Pro Store configuration pages
and Samsung US XML sitemap are experimental collectors, and Honor (CN
catalogue + comparison) and TCL (global catalogue) are experimental sources

candidates.name: chudbox
readme_excerpt: # Chudbox

Chudbox is the **Music / Death Metal Practice Lab** for [Dead Air University](https://github.com/anil-ganti-nbc/idle-time-learning-doodad). It is a tiny in-browser heavy-rhythm machine: tap pads, hit play, mutate a lane.
It also works **standalone**. Open it with no practice payload and it is just a sequencer. No accounts, no music-theory lecture, no setup.
## Relationship to Dead Air University
DAU remains authoritative for curriculum, mastery, SRS, and progression. Chudbox never writes DAU review intervals, quiz scores, or mastery.

Practice launch and result follow the canonical [DAU Practice Labs contract](https://github.com/anil-ganti-nbc/dau-practice-labs). Chudbox is a **separate implementation repository**. It is not inside `dau-practice-labs`.

candidates.name: dau-practice-labs
readme_excerpt: # DAU Practice Labs
Canonical contract for **DAU Practice Labs**, the umbrella of interactive companions around [Dead Air University](https://github.com/anil-ganti-nbc/idle-time-learning-doodad) (**DAU**).
This repository is the authoritative reference for:
- practice request schema
- practice result schema
- Practice Lab registry conventions
- transport conventions (`?practice=` and `dau:practice-result`)
- Chudbox compatibility adapter
- DAU / Practice Lab ownership boundary

candidates.name: dau-world-generator
readme_excerpt: # DAU World Generator
**Causal, seeded, validated diagnostic worlds for [Dead Air University](https://github.com/anil-ganti-nbc/idle-time-learning-doodad).**
A DAU World is a generated technical situation with hidden causes, observable
evidence, available actions, and consequences. Instead of asking the learner a
question, it hands them a system and requires them to work out what is
happening.
world state → system rules → observable evidence
